label: Qwen-Image-2512 T2I (true-CFG)
prompt: A futuristic cyberpunk city at night, neon lights reflecting on wet streets
negative_prompt: 低分辨率，低画质，肢体畸形，手指畸形，画面过饱和，蜡像感，人脸无细节，过度光滑，画面具有AI感。构图混乱。文字模糊，扭曲。
_note: Qwen-Image quality path = official diffusers true-CFG (true_cfg_scale=4.0 + negative_prompt), two transformer forwards per step. Sibling of the no-CFG qwen_image_2512_t2i_1024 (single forward). Both sglang and vLLM-Omni receive identical true_cfg_scale+negative_prompt via the shared payload, so the two-pass comparison is apples-to-apples. Provenance: sglang notes qwen_image_perf_issue_20260508.md.

h100-h200-2gpu-tp-speed-eager.description: H100 2-GPU SGLang Qwen-Image true-CFG: CFG parallelism (each GPU runs one CFG branch, no per-layer all-reduce) + resident + compile. Fastest for the 2-branch quality path.
h100-h200-2gpu-tp-speed-eager.sglang_ref: origin/main + PR #29774 (Shard QwenImage DiT across TP ranks; open, not yet merged)
h100-h200-2gpu-tp-speed-eager.notes: CFG parallelism is the cookbook-recommended Qwen multi-GPU path. Measured: 6.49s vs TP #29774 11.07s vs vLLM 10.14s (CFG-parallel 1.56x faster than vLLM). TP shards the DiT but RowParallel all-reduce dominates (~70% kernel time) for the 2-branch case; CFG-parallel avoids it. No #29774 needed here (DiT replicated, one branch per GPU).
